implemented: One explicitly selected and build-authorized trusted-linked ABI-2 analyzer on canonical, verified MIR; no dynamic ABI-2 activation.
proof: on1x/sdk/tests/check_linked_v2.py runs the actual on1xc; its C11 provider borrows the host snapshot and checks the expected instructions through immutable MIR traversal.

integration_hooks.change: After the existing ON1X_LINKED_SDK_EXTENSION block, include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/cmake/LinkedAnalyzerActivation.cmake") unconditionally. This wires ON1X_LINKED_SDK_EXTENSION_V2 (default empty) and rejects a configured provider in an SDK-disabled build.

At the existing call before the --ir-input branch, pass sdk_name: on1x::sdk_driver::check_plugin_selection(plugin_selectors,sdk_name);. This lets the driver reject mixed providers before compiling input and skip legacy environment checks for the trusted-linked ABI-2 profile, including when the dynamic worker is disabled.

Record a separate trusted-linked ABI-2 analyzer subset (single configured provider, explicitly named, canonical verified MIR, bounded diagnostics only). Do not claim the plugin worker runs ABI-2 facets, that dynamic manifest authorization activates a provider, or that PPX-v2 is implemented.

limits: Only the mir.analyze revision 1 grant; no candidate publication, artifacts, PPX or general phase callbacks.
128 unlocated diagnostics per call, each a nonempty NUL-free UTF-8 message of at most 4096 bytes. Bad sinks, failed runs or failed shutdown discard staged results.

Trusted native code has compiler process authority with no host-enforced CPU or wall-clock budget on callback execution. Compile only audited providers. Existing sandboxed ABI-1 worker remains unchanged.

verification.local_wiring: Historical validation used CMAKE_PROJECT_On1x_INCLUDE deferred inclusion of the linked-analyzer activation hook in the ignored build directory. The shared CLI and CMake sources were not edited during that validation.
verification.configuration: Release; BUILD_TESTING and dynamic SDK worker enabled; pinned ON1X_LIBSTONE_ROOT and ON1X_REQUIRE_LIBSTONE=ON; optional Syren, native PPX and native SDK reference disabled. ON1X_LINKED_SDK_EXTENSION points at tests/linked_extension.c; ON1X_LINKED_SDK_EXTENSION_V2 points at tests/linked_extension_v2.c.
